chunks: And in the narration of Jamil ibn Darraj and Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, he said:
"The earth is folded at the end of the night."

key_terms.آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ: the final part of the night
key_terms.تُطْوَى: is folded up or made traversable with ease

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying the earth is folded at the end of the night?
ai.summary: This hadith reports from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام that the earth is "folded" at the end of the night. In the chapter context, it indicates a special condition or facilitation connected to travel during that time.
